text_block_list.text:
When I visited the trainer's office, to my 
surprise, it had been cleaned spotless. 
The desk, the bookshelves, the entire room 
was sparkling...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! I just meant to do a little light 
cleaning to take a break from drafting 
strategies, and before I knew it, I'd gone 
this far...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, this is no time to be cleaning... 
Aaah, strategy proposals... I have to make 
the strategy proposals...!

Perhaps my mind isn't working properly due 
to fatigue... I should probably revise my 
upcoming schedule.
